ditchdiggers.m: More than one ditchdigger. ditchdigger: one who digs ditches.

ditchwater.m: The stagnant water that collects in a ditch.

ditheism.m: A belief in two deities, which may be in conflict with each other.

ditheist.m: One who holds the doctrine of ditheism.

ditheistic.m: Of or pertaining to ditheism, the belief in two gods.

ditheists.m: More than one ditheist. ditheist: one who holds the doctrine of ditheism.

ditherers.m: More than one ditherer. ditherer: one who dithers.

dithiocarbamate.m: Any salt or ester of dithiocarbamic acid.

dithiocarbamates.m: More than one dithiocarbamate. dithiocarbamate: any salt or ester of dithiocarbamic acid.

ditransitive.m: Of a class of verbs which take both a direct and an indirect object.

ditsy.m: Tending to fuss over small details.

dittography.m: The accidental error of repeating a word, phrase or combination of letters by a scribe or copyist.
